title: stage's Responses grid — ranks and time left
howToOpen: Open the event, click the pricing or auction stage's tab; the Responses sub-tab opens first.

reviewed.note: Runs on the same visit as the Responses map. There is no separate reverse-auction leaderboard for the buyer: the live view is the Responses grid kept fresh over the TradesChannel websocket (views/orderDetails/orderDetails.jsx:1344-1374). The ?tab=leaderboard view is the alternate-bidding leaderboard only (eventHeader.jsx:454-458).
